message.content:
The pattern appears to be “divide by 2 and round down to the nearest integer”:  
\(-8 \to -4 \to -2 \to -1\), and since \(\lfloor -1/2 \rfloor = -1\), it stays at \(-1\).

<answer>-1</answer>
